items.name: MakeExt
items.signature: trait MakeExt<T> where Self: MakeVisitor<T> + Sized + sealed::Sealed<MakeExtMarker<T>>

methods.name: debug_alt
methods.summary: Wraps `self` so that any `fmt::Debug` fields are recorded using the alternate formatter (`{:#?}`).

methods.name: delimited
methods.signature: fn delimited<D>(self, delimiter: D) -> delimited::Delimited<D, Self> where D: AsRef<str> + Clone, Self::Visitor: VisitFmt
methods.summary: Wraps `self` so that when fields are formatted to a writer, they are separated by the provided `delimiter`.

methods.name: display_messages
methods.summary: Wraps `self` so that any string fields named "message" are recorded using `fmt::Display`.

items.name: MakeOutput
items.signature: trait MakeOutput<T, Out> where Self: MakeVisitor<T> + sealed::Sealed<(T, Out)>, Self::Visitor: VisitOutput<Out>
items.summary: Extension trait implemented for all `MakeVisitor` implementations that produce a visitor implementing `VisitOutput`.

methods.name: visit_with
methods.signature: fn visit_with<F>(&self, target: T, fields: &F) -> Out where F: RecordFields
methods.summary: Visits all fields in `fields` with a new visitor constructed from `target`.

methods.name: make_visitor
methods.summary: Make a new visitor for the provided `target`.

items.name: RecordFields
items.summary: Extension trait implemented by types which can be recorded by a [visitor].

methods.name: record
methods.summary: Record all the fields in `self` with the provided `visitor`.

items.name: VisitFmt
items.summary: Extension trait implemented by visitors to indicate that they write to a `fmt::Write` instance, and allow access to that writer.

methods.name: writer
methods.summary: Returns the formatter that this visitor writes to.

items.name: VisitOutput
items.summary: A [visitor] that produces output once it has visited a set of fields.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Completes the visitor, returning any output.

methods.name: visit
methods.signature: fn visit<R>(self, fields: &R) -> Out where R: RecordFields, Self: Sized
methods.summary: Visit a set of fields, and return the output of finishing the visitor once the fields have been visited.

items.name: VisitWrite
items.summary: Extension trait implemented by visitors to indicate that they write to an `io::Write` instance, and allow access to that writer.

methods.name: writer
methods.summary: Returns the writer that this visitor writes to.
